doc: Monster script for the Pirate Tank family (Pirate Tank, Pirate Eye, Angry Canon, Iron Ghost; kinds 216 to 219). It fires a fast shot and, from its dcol0 muzzle in a puff of M smoke, launches a Bomb monster (kind 1002 plus its grade, run by e25a_bomb). It keeps its distance with backward and sideways walking and switches behaviour by distance and rage hits.
